title: 04 · Skeuomorphism · Fenmoor STEM-8 post console
strengths: Hardware drawn with consistent light: knurled aluminium knobs with pointers on 270° scales, ridged fader caps in inset slots, LED ladders with dim unlit segments, LCD glass with backlit text, a brushed aluminium faceplate with engraved legends

Every mark is a value: fader caps sit at their dB on a console scale and plates repeat it, meters light to their stated peaks with zones at −18 and −6 dBFS and their own dBFS scale, the loudness section reads −24.1 LKFS integrated, −3.2 dBTP true peak, 6.4 LU range against a −24 ±2 spec

Post-production truth a re-recording mixer would check: DX boom and lav (lav muted), ADR, Foley, hard FX, backgrounds, score, reverb return, HPF corners per stem, dialog-gated loudness, a 5.1 bus with LFE, Ep 104 reel 3 at 01:12:46:08
slop_signals: The loudness history is a smooth sine wave around −24; real short-term loudness is jagged and stepped, so the one live graph looks generated
Every knob is the same CSS-rendered disc with the same highlight; next to a rendered product (Telepathic Instruments) the metal has no material variety or wear
The brushed header with letter-spaced 'FENMOOR' is a stock hardware-skin move
fixes: Replace the sine with a realistic short-term trace: dialogue peaks, quiet stretches, a step where a cue starts
Vary the caps (trim against EQ colours, as consoles do) and add a little anisotropic highlight so the knobs read as turned metal
Check the reel and timecode convention with someone from post: reels usually run at their own hour (Reel 3 at 03:00:00:00)

references.what: A rendered hardware instrument lit like a real object: the bar for knob and cap material
Shipped web audio editing: flat tracks and waveforms, the opposite approach
Dubbing editor with per-speaker tracks; how audio tools on the web usually look

facts: [convention, low confidence] 'Reel 3' with timecode 01:12:46:08: in film post each reel usually starts at its own hour (03:00:00:00); a TV mix on 01: would not normally be called by reel
